changes: Uses less of the Rytm's CPU while no pad is retriggering: with nothing to do, each audio block now takes a few reads instead of a full pass, leaving more for the rest of the Rytm.
Recording, Retrig Grid and the RTRG key work as in 0.2.0.
First release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74: LIVE RECORDING records every pad retrig hit, from RTRG + pad or an ALWAYS ON pad, as a real trig with the velocity and timing you played.
While the sequencer plays, pad retrigs fall on its swung grid (Retrig Grid by stigmagit), and a recorded roll starts on it. QUANT RTRG TO SEQ in GLOBAL > CONTROL > SEQUENCER CONFIG turns this off.
Rates faster than a step record one trig with a step retrig.
In the RETRIG menu, YES turns ALWAYS ON over on every row, and the RTRG key glows dim red while the selected track is ALWAYS ON.
Known issue: above swing 50, rates of 1/20 and faster play back a little unlike the live roll. Not yet tested with external MIDI clock.
